National Survey of Family Growth

National Survey of Family Growth

A survey of US men and women aged 15-49 about family life, marriage and divorce, pregnancy, infertility, contraception, and health. Released in cycles; cycle 12 is 2022-2023.

Publisher
National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), CDC
Dataset
https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nsfg/
Terms
https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html
The NCHS Data User Agreement for public-use files (also in the 2022-2023 User's Guide, pp. 4-5) restricts use to statistical reporting and analysis and forbids identifying anyone, linking to identifiable data, and research on re-identification; none of its terms concerns redistribution. NCHS documentation is a US government work in the public domain. Allen Downey reviewed this in MarriageNSFG Task 20 (2026-11-10); recorded here from that review, pending his confirmation for this repo.
Citation
National Center for Health Statistics, National Survey of Family Growth, 2022-2023 and 2017-2019.
wave
cycle — Cycle 12 is 2022-2023. Earlier cycles are 3 (1982) to 11 (2017-2019).
